name: Thassa
description: Thassa is the god of the sea on Theros, whom the tritons serve and whose signature weapon is the bident.

description_citations.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

summary.text: Thassa is the god of the sea on Theros, whom the tritons serve and whose signature weapon is the bident.

bio.text: The tritons, who say they are ever in her service, took the newly arrived Kiora for Thassa, and Kiora let them believe she was a god.

citations.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

bio.text: Kiora earned Thassa's ire, and the two came to open conflict.

citations.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.
"Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

bio.text: Thassa shifted into her triton form and summoned the krakens of Theros, with Arixmethes siding with her, while Kiora brought her own armada.

bio.text: Kiora's serpent turned on her and half her krakens turned against her, and Thassa parted the sea into an arena, accused Kiora of leading her people astray, and pinned her to a boulder with the thrown bident.

bio.text: Kiora took the bident and planeswalked away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.

bio.text: The bident dried to coral when Kiora reached Zendikar still clutching it.

status.text: As of the latest mention in October 2016, Thassa is still Theros's sea god, with Thrasios believing he has her divine sanction, and her bident remains in Kiora's hands as far as the material shows.

timeline.summary: Kiora meets native tritons and learns she is on Theros near Meletis, where they take her for Thassa.
timeline.quote: "You are on Theros ," he said. "You are in the mortal world."

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora lets the tritons believe she is a god and privately questions Kalemnos about whether he believes she is Thassa.
timeline.quote: "And do you believe I am Thassa?"

citation.text: "Kiora's Followers" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2014.

timeline.summary: Kiora dives beneath the waves as Thassa, as the Great Eye, bursts from the water.
timeline.quote: Kiora cast a spell to aid her swimming

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora rises with her armada and sees Thassa on the Monsoon; Thassa sends Elspeth and Ajani away on a great wave.
timeline.quote: Thassa stepped off the deck of the Monsoon

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa shifts into her triton form and summons the krakens of Theros as Arixmethes sides with her.
timeline.quote: He was also, for the moment, on Thassa's side.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: The two armies clash as hundreds of tritons arrive to watch; Thassa taunts Kiora.
timeline.quote: "Bear witness to the fall of the pretender!"

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora tries to wrest Arixmethes from Thassa by bonding with his mind, but fails.
timeline.quote: You are not mine

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora's serpent turns on her and devours dozens of tritons, and half her krakens turn against her.
timeline.quote: devouring dozens in one bite.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Thassa parts the sea into an arena, accuses Kiora of leading her people astray, and pins her to a boulder with the thrown bident.
timeline.quote: It slammed into her and pinned her to one of the boulders

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora takes the bident and planeswalks away with it, leaving Thassa crying out in anguish.
timeline.quote: melted away into the void, Thassa's weapon still clutched in her hands.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

timeline.summary: Kiora planeswalks to Zendikar still clutching Thassa's bident, which dries to coral.
timeline.quote: There, still clutched tightly in both hands, was the weapon of a god.

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
timeline.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Callaphe is revealed to be the planeswalker Kiora.
timeline.quote: Callaphe revealed that her identity was a falsehood and that she was in truth the merfolk planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora lands on Theros and calls a tsunami that devastates Meletis, and the Tritons take her for an avatar of Thassa.
timeline.quote: It struck the polis of Meletis and caused untold destruction

citation.text: "Kiora", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora leads them to Arixmethes, a kraken, and Thassa refuses to let Kiora take it while helping Elspeth and Ajani.
timeline.quote: a massive kraken upon whom a city had been built

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a battle with sea monsters, Kiora escapes with Thassa's bident Dekella.
timeline.quote: Kiora escaped mostly unharmed and clutching Thassa's magical bident Dekella .

citation.text: "Kiora", section "Journey into Nyx". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dakra Isles emerge where Thassa's tears fell after Queen Korinna's death.
timeline.quote: these magical islands emerged where Thassa's tears fell after the death of Queen Korinna

citation.text: "Siren Sea", section "Locations of the Siren Sea". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A mortal steals Dekella to destroy a rival fleet and Thassa turns his family into eels (legend).
timeline.quote: Thassa turned his family into eels

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kiora steals Dekella and Thassa receives a new divine spear from Purphoros.
timeline.quote: Dekella was later stolen by the planeswalker Kiora

citation.text: "Thassa", section "Divine weapon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thassa is affected by the Silence of the Gods.
